Package com.salesforce.multicloudj.kms.driver

Class AbstractKms

java.lang.Object
com.salesforce.multicloudj.kms.driver.AbstractKms
All Implemented Interfaces:
Provider, SdkService, KeyManagement, AutoCloseable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AliKms, AwsKms, GcpKms
public abstract class AbstractKms extends Object implements KeyManagement, AutoCloseable
Base class for key management provider implementations. Public operations validate their input and then delegate to the provider's do* methods.

    • enableKey

      public void enableKey(KeyRef keyRef)
      Enables a key so it can be used for cryptographic operations. When KeyRef.getVersionId() is set, providers that keep state per version enable only that version; the others enable the whole key.
      Specified by:
      enableKey in interface KeyManagement
      Parameters:
      keyRef - the key to enable

    • disableKey

      public void disableKey(KeyRef keyRef)
      Disables a key so it can no longer be used for cryptographic operations. When KeyRef.getVersionId() is set, providers that keep state per version disable only that version; the others disable the whole key.
      Specified by:
      disableKey in interface KeyManagement
      Parameters:

    • supportsMultiRegionKeys

      public boolean supportsMultiRegionKeys()
      Whether keys created by this client can be made available across regions with CreateKeyRequest.multiRegion. May depend on configuration such as the key container.

      Providers that can create multi-region keys override this.

      Specified by:
      supportsMultiRegionKeys in interface KeyManagement
      Returns:
      true if multi-region keys can be created

      protected abstract CreateKeyResponse doCreateKey(CreateKeyRequest request)
